title.zh: 「最後五百公尺」：自主終端導引只讓單機貴一成，卻把防守方便宜五個數量級的那一層從棋盤上刪掉
title.en: The Last 500 Meters: Terminal Autonomy Costs an Attacker 10% More Per Drone and Deletes the Defender's Cheapest Layer, Which Was Five Orders of Magnitude Cheaper

focus.zh: 自主終端導引正在擴散，推力不是技術突破而是算術：模組讓單機成本只增約一成、效果卻增 2 到 4 倍，同時繞開了防守方唯一每次接戰只要美分等級的 EW 層——而 EW 同時也是最便宜的廣域偵測層，所以攻擊方刪掉的不只是攔截手段，還有「該往哪裡看」。更關鍵的是，這個架構剛好長成各國法律「人類選定目標」那條例外的形狀，而這條線從機外根本不可驗證；唯一驗證得了的東西（未加密的機上模組）正在消失。台灣審計部剛用審計語言確認了同一個機制。
focus.en: Terminal autonomy is spreading not because of a technical breakthrough but because of arithmetic: the module adds roughly ten percent to a drone's unit cost and multiplies strike effectiveness two- to fourfold, while removing the one counter-drone layer that costs cents per engagement. Because electronic warfare is also the defender's cheapest wide-area sensor, what the attacker deletes is not only the intercept but the cueing — the knowledge of where to look. More consequentially, the spreading architecture is shaped exactly like the exception every state's law already carves out for human target selection, and that line cannot be verified from outside the airframe. The only thing that ever verified it — unencrypted onboard modules — is about to disappear. Taiwan's national audit just confirmed the same mechanism in its own language.

title.zh: 成本 +10%、效果 ×2–4：推動自主擴散的不是任何戰略決定，是採購官看得懂的除法
title.en: Plus 10% Cost, Times Two-to-Four Effect: What Is Spreading Autonomy Is Not a Strategic Decision, It Is Long Division

summary.zh: Ukraine 大廠 Vyriy 把 Kyiv 自主技術公司 The Fourth Law 的 TFL-1 終端導引模組裝上其主力 Vyriy-10 之後，整機售價約 448 美元；公開資料指模組讓單機成本上升約一成，打擊效果卻提高 2 至 4 倍，做法是在最後約 500 公尺把控制權從操作者移交給機上電腦，藉此同時克服 EW 干擾與無線電視距限制。烏方總參謀部、國防部與數位轉型部均已公開要求擴大此類方案規模，業界預期 6 至 9 個月內前線多數無人機將配備同類模組。把這個數字對照防守方：反無人機的每次接戰成本橫跨五個數量級以上，EW 效應約在美分等級，機砲類效應在 2,000 美元以內，可程式空炸彈約 11,000 至 27,000 歐元，攔截無人機約 15,000 美元，先進飛彈攔截器則要 300 至 500 萬美元。
summary.en: Vyriy, one of Ukraine's largest drone manufacturers, now sells its flagship Vyriy-10 fitted with the TFL-1 terminal guidance module from Kyiv autonomy firm The Fourth Law for roughly $448 per unit. Published figures put the module's cost premium at about ten percent and the gain in strike effectiveness at two to four times, achieved by handing control from the operator to an onboard computer for the final ~500 meters, which simultaneously defeats EW jamming and radio-horizon limits. Ukraine's General Staff, Ministry of Defense and Ministry of Digital Transformation have all publicly pushed to scale such systems, and industry expects most front-line drones to carry comparable autonomy within six to nine months. Set that against the defender's side: counter-drone cost per engagement spans more than five orders of magnitude — on the order of a cent for EW effects, under $2,000 for gun-based effectors, roughly EUR 11,000–27,000 for a programmable airburst engagement, about $15,000 for an interceptor drone, and $3–5 million for an advanced missile interceptor.

implication.zh: 評估任何一方的無人機戰力時，該追蹤的指標要從「機體月產量」換成「自主模組的月產量與整合率」。機體產能是舊的瓶頸，操作員人數才是真正的天花板——而自主模組正是專門用來拆這個天花板的零件。這也解釋了為什麼 Zelensky 會把單位從「一次行動打幾架」換成「一天穩定打幾架」（見本站 8/30 報告）：一天 1,000 架若靠人力，等於要 1,000 名受過訓的操作員；靠模組，只要 1,000 顆模組。對投資判斷而言，值得盯的不是無人機整機廠，是導引模組、光學感測與非 RF 偵測這三段。
implication.en: When you assess anyone's drone force, switch your tracking metric from airframes produced per month to autonomy modules produced and integrated per month. Airframe output was the old bottleneck; trained operators are the real ceiling, and the autonomy module is the component built specifically to break that ceiling. It also explains why Zelensky reset the unit of account from sorties-per-attack to sorties-per-day (see our 30 Aug brief): a thousand drones a day flown by people requires a thousand trained operators, but flown by modules it requires a thousand modules. For investment purposes, the interesting layer is not airframe assembly — it is guidance modules, optical sensing, and non-RF detection.

counterpoint.zh: 防守方的成本曲線未必真的翻轉。Ukraine 的 Sky Fortress 聲學預警網以約 14,000 個節點、單價 400 至 1,000 美元、覆蓋全國約八成面積的規模運作，完全不依賴目標發射無線電，總體造價據報低於 500 萬美元。若廣域偵測能用這種價格重建，那麼「防守方被迫走向昂貴感測」的推論就過頭了。但要誠實記下限制：該網目前僅以純聲學數據追蹤到進入烏克蘭空域目標的約兩成。
counterpoint.en: The defender's cost curve may not actually invert. Ukraine's Sky Fortress acoustic early-warning network runs on roughly 14,000 nodes at $400–1,000 each, covers about 80 percent of the country, depends not at all on the target emitting radio, and reportedly cost under $5 million in total. If wide-area cueing can be rebuilt at that price, the claim that defenders are forced onto expensive sensing is overstated. The honest limit: that network currently tracks only about 20 percent of targets entering Ukrainian airspace on acoustic data alone.

items.source: Kyiv Post / The Fourth Law / Inside Unmanned Systems / Drone Warfare

title.zh: Zaporizhzhia 那架 Molniya 沒有天線，但機上模組沒加密——這一代自主武器留下了它最後一次可被鑑識的機會
title.en: The Zaporizhzhia Molniya Carried No Antenna, But Its Module Carried No Encryption — This Generation Left Behind Its Last Forensically Readable Artifact

summary.zh: 紐約時報調查（引述烏方防空指揮官、無人機專家與檢驗殘骸的鑑識團隊）確認：7 月 6 日在 Zaporizhzhia 一座加油站造成 3 名平民死亡（含 19 歲會計系學生 Tetiana Bubynets 與 2 名 41、48 歲男性）的俄軍 Molniya 攻擊，其最終瞄準點由機上 Nvidia Jetson Orin 模組上訓練過的物件辨識軟體自行選定（丙烷儲罐），人類操作者僅將其朝加油站大方向發射。殘骸未搭載對外通訊天線，全程未偵測到無線電訊號。關鍵在於：這起攻擊的殘骸與另外查獲的完整測試機上的模組都未加密，調查人員因此能直接讀出為視覺導航載入的地形影像，以及指定該機受訓攻擊哪些物件類別的程式碼。CSIS 資深研究員 Kateryna Bondar 稱此為首起有紀錄、由俄方全自主鎖定造成平民死亡的案例。Molniya 本身是膠合板與泡棉機身、單價約 300 至 1,600 美元、每月發射數以千計的廉價機型。
summary.en: A New York Times investigation, citing Ukrainian air defense commanders, drone specialists and the forensic team that examined the wreckage, established that the 6 July strike on a filling station in Zaporizhzhia — which killed three civilians, including 19-year-old accounting student Tetiana Bubynets and two men aged 41 and 48 — had its final aim point chosen onboard. Software running on an Nvidia Jetson Orin module, trained to recognize object classes including propane tanks, selected the specific target; human operators had only launched the drone toward the general area. The wreck carried no external communications antenna and no radio emission was detected during the flight. The decisive detail: modules from this wreck and from intact captured test drones carried no encryption, so investigators could read both the terrain imagery loaded for visual navigation and the code specifying which object classes the drone had been trained to attack. CSIS senior fellow Kateryna Bondar called it the first documented case of civilian deaths caused by Russian fully autonomous targeting. The Molniya itself is a plywood-and-foam airframe costing roughly $300–1,600 and launched by the thousand each month.

implication.zh: 對做 provenance graph 的人來說，這開出一個全新的證據類別：一次自主攻擊的「決策紀錄」是可以從實體殘骸重建的——不是靠推論行為模式，而是靠直接讀出目標類別清單與導航影像。這比任何網路空間的歸因都更接近「一手證據」。但也要看清這個窗口的性質：它是製造方的疏忽，不是體系的性質。當下一批殘骸開始出現加密或開機自抹除，這條證據鏈會整段消失，而「是誰選了這個目標」將永久退回不可驗證。
implication.en: For anyone working on provenance graphs, this opens a genuinely new evidence class: the decision record of an autonomous strike can be reconstructed from physical wreckage — not inferred from behavioral patterns, but read directly off the target-class list and the navigation imagery. That is closer to primary evidence than almost anything available in cyber attribution. But be clear about the nature of this window: it exists through a manufacturer's oversight, not through any property of the system. Once recovered modules start shipping with encryption or boot-time self-wipe, the entire evidentiary chain disappears and the question of who selected the target becomes permanently unverifiable.

counterpoint.zh: 把這起事件當成「機器自己決定殺人」的分水嶺，可能高估了它。人類確實把該機朝那座加油站發射——在多數國家現行的法律定義下，這足以主張操作者選定了「特定目標群」，機上軟體只是執行終端導引。這不是詭辯：這正是下一段要談的法律接縫，而且辯得贏。
counterpoint.en: Reading this as the moment a machine decided to kill on its own probably overstates it. A human did launch the drone toward that specific filling station, and under most states' current legal definitions that is enough to argue the operator selected a specific target group while onboard software merely provided terminal guidance. This is not sophistry — it is precisely the legal seam discussed below, and it is an argument that wins.

items.source: The New York Times / Tom's Hardware / Meduza / CSIS

title.zh: 台灣審計部把同一個機制寫進年度報告：反無人機系統落後 6 至 12 個月，對 FOG-D 與 AI 導航無人機「無可行反制手段」
title.en: Taiwan's National Audit Office Put the Same Mechanism in Writing: The Counter-Drone System Is 6–12 Months Late and Has No Viable Countermeasure Against Fiber-Optic or AI-Guided Drones

summary.zh: 台灣審計部 2026 年度決算審核報告指出，空軍委由 NCSIST 開發的反無人機系統存在多項缺口：無法偵測或干擾新型解放軍無人機使用的 5.1GHz 頻段、無法偵測 Beidou-3 部分頻段、且對光纖導引無人機（FOG-D）與 AI 導航無人機不具可行反制手段；計畫並因工程延宕與關鍵零組件短缺而落後 6 至 12 個月，報告警告此缺口可能危及軍事基地防護。台灣現行反無人機作法高度依賴 EW、訊號干擾與電子壓制，而這正是上述兩類目標最不受影響的一層。制度面同時在動：立法院 8 月 27 日通過在野版六年 NT$2,400 億（約 75.6 億美元）無人機方案，取代行政院版 NT$2,100 億特別預算（見本站 8/28、8/30 報告）；此前 2025 年 10 月的 14 億美元「民主無人機供應鏈」計畫中，僅約 3,200 萬美元專門編列於 EW 韌性（AESA 雷達、CRPA 天線、加密資料鏈），並開始投入視覺里程計與慣性導航等非 GNSS 手段。解放軍 5 月單月侵入台灣 ADIZ 達 217 架次。
summary.en: Taiwan's National Audit Office report for fiscal 2026 identifies multiple gaps in the counter-drone system the air force commissioned from NCSIST: it cannot detect or disrupt the 5.1 GHz band used by newer PLA drone models, cannot detect certain Beidou-3 bandwidths, and has no viable countermeasures against fiber-optic guided drones (FOG-D) or AI-guided navigation. The program is six to twelve months behind schedule owing to construction delays and shortages of key components, and the report warns the shortfall could undermine protection of military bases. Taiwan's counter-drone approach leans heavily on EW, signal disruption and jamming — precisely the layer those two target classes are built to ignore. The institutional picture is moving at the same time: on 27 August the Legislative Yuan passed the opposition's six-year NT$240 billion (~$7.56 billion) drone program in place of the Executive Yuan's NT$210 billion special budget (see our 28 and 30 Aug briefs), while within the $1.4 billion Democratic Drone Supply Chain plan approved in October 2025, only about $32 million was earmarked specifically for EW resilience (AESA radars, CRPA antennas, encrypted datalinks) alongside work on non-GNSS methods such as visual odometry and inertial guidance. The PLA flew 217 aerial incursions into Taiwan's ADIZ in May alone.

implication.zh: 這是本週對你最直接的一條，因為它同時是防務判斷與投資判斷。審計報告的價值不在於「台灣落後了」這個結論，而在於它把缺口定位在偵測端而非攔截端——5.1GHz 與 Beidou-3 頻段偵測不到，意味著問題發生在感測，不是火力。因此新通過的 NT$2,400 億若主要流向機體與產線（該法案主管機關已從 MND 改為 MOEA，本身就偏產業扶植而非戰力生成），缺口只會擴大。判斷這筆錢有沒有花對，指標很具體：非 RF 偵測（聲學陣列、光學／紅外追蹤、被動雷達）與國產終端自主模組這兩項的佔比。
implication.en: This is the week's most directly actionable item for you, because it is simultaneously a defense judgment and an investment one. The audit's value is not the conclusion that Taiwan is behind; it is that the gap sits on the detection side rather than the intercept side. Not being able to detect 5.1 GHz or certain Beidou-3 bands is a sensing failure, not a firepower failure. So if the newly passed NT$240 billion flows mainly into airframes and production lines — and note the program's lead agency shifted from MND to MOEA, which tilts it toward industrial policy rather than force generation — the gap widens rather than closes. The metric for whether the money is well spent is concrete: the share going to non-RF detection (acoustic arrays, electro-optical/IR tracking, passive radar) and to indigenous terminal autonomy modules.

items.source: Taipei Times / 中華民國審計部 / The Defense Post / Defense Express

title.zh: DoDD 3000.09 從來沒有禁止終端自主——它是明文允許的；正在擴散的架構恰好長成這條例外的形狀
title.en: DoDD 3000.09 Never Banned Terminal Autonomy — It Expressly Permits It, and the Spreading Architecture Is Shaped Exactly Like That Exception

summary.zh: 美國國防部 DoDD 3000.09（2012 年發布、2023 年 1 月更新）將 LAWS 定義為「一經啟動即可在無人類操作者進一步介入下選定並接戰目標的武器系統」，但同時明確允許武器系統在接戰相關功能上運用自主，包括「獲取、追蹤、辨識潛在目標、目標提示、目標排序、開火時機，以及對已選定目標進行終端導引」——條件是操作者保留對「個別目標與特定目標群」的選擇權。射後不理武器（如 Javelin 一類）被歸類為「人在迴路內」的半自主系統。也就是說，「人類朝某區域發射、機器在最後數百公尺自行選定瞄準點」這個正在量產的架構，在現行美方定義下完全可以被辯護為半自主。CCW 第七次審查會議訂於 2026 年 11 月 16 至 20 日舉行，GGE 的三年授權將在此屆滿並提交最終報告。
summary.en: US DoD Directive 3000.09 (issued 2012, updated January 2023) defines LAWS as a weapon system that, once activated, can select and engage targets without further intervention by a human operator — while expressly permitting weapon systems to use autonomy for engagement-related functions including acquiring, tracking, identifying potential targets, cueing, prioritizing targets, timing when to fire, and providing terminal guidance to home in on selected targets, provided the operator retains control over the selection of individual targets and specific target groups. Fire-and-forget munitions of the Javelin class are classified as human-in-the-loop semi-autonomous systems. Which means the architecture now entering mass production — a human launches toward an area, the machine picks the aim point in the last few hundred meters — is fully defensible as semi-autonomous under the prevailing US definition. The CCW's Seventh Review Conference is scheduled for 16–20 November 2026, where the GGE's three-year mandate expires and its final report is due.

implication.zh: 跟任何一國官員談這個題目時，第一個該問的不是立場而是定義：他用的「人類控制」錨在哪一層？錨在「選定個別目標」，則 Molniya 那次攻擊合規；錨在「選定瞄準點」，則不合規。雙方可以在完全不改變事實描述的情況下得出相反結論，而多數公開辯論之所以各說各話，原因就在這裡。更實際的一點是：這條線是行為要件，不是技術特徵，所以它從機外無法觀測——沒有任何情報手段能從外部區分一架半自主機與一架全自主機。這使得核查（verification）而非禁令（prohibition）才是這個議題真正的難處。
implication.en: In any conversation with an official on this subject, the first question is not their position but their definition: at which layer is their notion of human control anchored? Anchor it at selecting individual targets and the Zaporizhzhia strike is compliant. Anchor it at selecting the aim point and it is not. Two parties can reach opposite conclusions without disagreeing on a single fact, which is why most public debate on this talks past itself. The more practical point: this line is a behavioral condition, not a technical feature, so it is unobservable from outside the airframe. No intelligence method distinguishes a semi-autonomous drone from a fully autonomous one externally. That makes verification, not prohibition, the actual hard problem here.

counterpoint.zh: 也完全可以主張這條線畫得合理，而我把它說成「接縫」是誤讀。終端尋標器已存在四十餘年，Javelin、Brimstone 一類射後不理武器早就把最後階段交給機器，國際社會從未視之為自主武器問題。若如此，真正改變的並不是自主的性質，而是它的單價與產量——一顆 Javelin 十幾萬美元、一架 Molniya 幾百美元。那麼該管的就是產量、目標類別清單的揭露與可歸責性，而不是重畫「人類選定目標」這條定義線。
counterpoint.en: It is equally arguable that the line is drawn correctly and that calling it a seam is my misreading. Terminal seekers have existed for over forty years; fire-and-forget weapons like Javelin and Brimstone have long handed the endgame to a machine, and no one treated that as an autonomous weapons problem. If so, what changed is not the nature of the autonomy but its unit cost and volume — a Javelin costs six figures, a Molniya a few hundred dollars. On that reading the right levers are production volume, disclosure of target-class lists, and accountability, not redrawing the definition of human target selection.

items.source: US DoD Directive 3000.09 / Lieber Institute West Point / UNODA

title.zh: 中國提議禁「使用」但不禁「開發」，同一天空軍公布全自主蜂群競賽：四方立場各自成立，互相攻擊的點也各自精準
title.en: China Proposes Banning Use But Not Development, and on the Same Day Its Air Force Announced a Fully Autonomous Swarm Challenge: Four Positions, Each Internally Coherent, Each Aimed at a Real Weak Point

summary.zh: 2026 年 4 月，中國代表團表達願意就一項 CCW 新議定書進行談判並締結，內容為禁止「完全自主致命武器系統的使用」——代表團明確強調該禁令僅限於使用，不涵蓋開發；同一日，中國空軍公布了一項評估全自主無人機蜂群進展的競賽計畫。北京同時維持既有表述：CCW 是討論 LAWS 最適當的場域，支持在「條件成熟」時談判具拘束力的國際文書。俄羅斯則採最小主義立場，主張現行 IHL 已充分涵蓋高度自主武器、不需要新規則，並警告拘束性文件會不公平限制投資自主能力的國家、甚至波及民用高科技發展；莫斯科長期以 CCW 的共識決作為程序否決工具。美國反對固定門檻，主張標準應為「對武力使用行使適當程度的人類判斷」。2025 年 9 月，巴西代表 42 國發表聯合聲明，指滾動文本已具備「兩層式路徑」（禁止部分、規範其餘）的要素，約佔 CCW 128 個締約國的三分之一。烏克蘭在 2024 年聯大 A/79/408 決議中投下棄權（166 國贊成，Belarus、北韓、Russia 反對）。
summary.en: In April 2026 the Chinese delegation expressed a desire to negotiate and conclude a new CCW protocol banning the use of fully autonomous lethal weapon systems — stressing explicitly that the prohibition covers use only, not development. The same day, China's air force released details of a challenge to evaluate progress in fully autonomous drone swarms. Beijing simultaneously maintains its standing formula: the CCW is the appropriate forum, and it supports negotiating a legally binding instrument when conditions are mature. Russia takes a minimalist line — existing IHL already covers highly autonomous systems, no new rules are needed, and a binding instrument would unfairly constrain states investing in autonomy while chilling civilian high technology; Moscow has long used the CCW's consensus rule as a procedural veto. The United States resists fixed thresholds, arguing the standard should be appropriate levels of human judgment over the use of force. In September 2025 Brazil delivered a joint statement for 42 states — roughly a third of the CCW's 128 parties — holding that the rolling text already contains the elements of a two-tier approach prohibiting some systems and regulating others. Ukraine abstained on UN General Assembly resolution A/79/408 (166 in favour; Belarus, North Korea and Russia against).

implication.zh: 這四種立場不是「支持管制 vs 反對管制」的光譜，而是四種對「管制該咬在生命週期哪一段」的不同主張：中國咬使用、俄國什麼都不咬、美國咬指揮判斷、巴西集團咬武器類型。你若要與任一方對談，把對話錨在生命週期而非道德立場，會比複述任何一方的官方修辭有用得多。特別注意中國那組：只禁使用而不禁開發，對已在開發階段領先或快速追趕的一方最有利——這不必然是虛偽，但它確實是有結構性報酬的設計。
implication.en: These four are not points on a spectrum from pro-regulation to anti-regulation. They are four different claims about where in a weapon's life cycle regulation should bite: China at use, Russia nowhere, the United States at command judgment, the Brazil group at weapon category. If you are talking to any of them, anchoring the conversation to the life cycle rather than to moral posture will get you further than restating anyone's official rhetoric. Note the Chinese construction in particular: a ban on use but not development advantages whoever is ahead in, or fastest at, development. That is not necessarily hypocrisy, but it is a design with a structural payoff.

title.zh: 出口管制盯著資料中心 GPU，改變戰場的卻是一顆邊緣模組：S-71M 殘骸裡那顆 Jetson Orin NX 生產於 2025 年 3 月
title.en: Export Control Watches Datacenter GPUs While the Battlefield Was Changed by an Edge Module: The Jetson Orin NX in the S-71M Wreck Was Manufactured in March 2025

summary.zh: 烏克蘭軍事情報總局（HUR）8 月 12 日公布，已自俄軍 S-71M「Monochrome」巡弋飛彈殘骸中取出一顆 Nvidia Jetson Orin NX 模組，該模組生產於 2025 年 3 月，即 Nvidia 正式退出俄羅斯業務三年多之後。Jetson Orin NX 為邊緣運算用的系統模組，具 1,024 個 CUDA 核心、32 個 Tensor 核心，稀疏 INT8 算力達 157 TOPS。HUR 先前已通報同型模組被用於 Shahed MS001 無人機，執行機上決策與終端導引。HUR 累計已在 202 種俄製武器系統中辨識出 5,816 項外國製零組件。Nvidia 回應稱公司遵守適用法律、要求客戶同樣遵守，並將終止與經查違反美國出口法規客戶的業務往來。對照組是本站 8/26 報告追蹤的 H200 配額體系：ByteDance 與 Tencent 各約取得 1 萬顆，僅為法定許可上限 7.5 萬顆的約 13%。
summary.en: On 12 August Ukraine's military intelligence directorate (HUR) announced it had recovered an Nvidia Jetson Orin NX module from the wreckage of a Russian S-71M Monochrome cruise missile. The module was manufactured in March 2025, more than three years after Nvidia formally exited direct operations in Russia. The Orin NX is an edge-computing system-on-module with 1,024 CUDA cores, 32 Tensor cores and up to 157 sparse INT8 TOPS. HUR had previously reported the same module family in Shahed MS001 drones performing onboard decision-making and terminal guidance, and has now identified 5,816 foreign-made components across 202 Russian weapons systems. Nvidia responded that it complies with applicable law, expects customers to do the same, and would cease business with any customer found to have violated US export law. Compare the H200 quota regime tracked in our 26 Aug brief: ByteDance and Tencent have each taken delivery of roughly 10,000 units against a licensed ceiling of 75,000 each — about 13 percent.

implication.zh: 現行管制邏輯是為「訓練瓶頸」設計的：管住最先進的資料中心加速器，就能拖慢對手的大模型訓練。但改變 Zaporizhzhia 那天結果的推論工作，發生在一顆為機器人與零售場景大量出貨的邊緣模組上——它便宜、民用、全球流通，而且有本土替代路徑。這是一個結構性的錯配：管制資源集中在算力的上游，而軍事效用出現在下游且不需要尖端製程。對你追蹤出口管制的意義是，未來 BIS 若把注意力往邊緣推論模組延伸，那將是管制邏輯的實質轉向，而非既有清單的擴充；若不推，則現行清單對這一類戰場能力基本無效。
implication.en: The current control logic was designed around a training bottleneck: restrict the most advanced datacenter accelerators and you slow an adversary's frontier model training. But the inference work that determined the outcome in Zaporizhzhia ran on an edge module shipped in volume for robotics and retail — cheap, civilian, globally distributed, and with domestic substitutes available. That is a structural mismatch: control resources are concentrated upstream in compute while military utility appears downstream and requires no leading-edge process node. For your export-control tracking, the signal to watch is whether BIS extends attention to edge inference modules. If it does, that is a genuine reorientation of the control logic rather than an expansion of existing lists. If it does not, the current lists are effectively inert against this class of battlefield capability.

narrative.zh:
**問題是什麼**

過去兩年關於無人機的討論幾乎都繞著數量打轉：一天打 300 架還是 1,000 架。但數量從來不是真正的變數。真正的變數只有一個：每一架無人機在最後幾百公尺，需不需要一個人。這聽起來像工程細節，卻同時決定三件事——攻擊方能不能把產量換成打擊量、防守方最便宜的那層防禦還在不在、以及事後能不能證明那次攻擊是誰決定的。

**機制怎麼運作**

先看攻擊方的算術。Vyriy-10 裝上 TFL-1 終端導引模組後售價約 448 美元，成本上升約一成、打擊效果提高 2 至 4 倍。成本 +10%、效果 ×2~4，這就是引擎——它不需要誰做出「要不要走向自主」的戰略決定，只需要採購官看得懂除法。

再看防守方。反無人機每次接戰成本橫跨五個數量級以上：EW 效應約在美分等級，機砲類 2,000 美元以內，先進飛彈攔截器 300 至 500 萬美元。EW 便宜到近乎免費，是因為它不消耗彈藥——它攻擊的是那條無線電鏈路本身。而 TFL-1 這類模組把最後 500 公尺交給機上電腦，Molniya 更進一步，整機不帶對外通訊天線。沒有鏈路就沒有可干擾的東西：攻擊方付一成溢價，刪掉了防守方便宜五個數量級的那一層。

被刪掉的還不只是攔截。EW 同時是防守方最便宜的廣域被動感測器，它靠聽無線電訊號知道有東西進來。面對 RF 靜默的目標，你不只是擋不住，你連該往哪裡看都不知道。防守方於是被迫退回聲學、光學與雷達——成本隨防守面積成長，而不隨威脅數量成長。這才是真正壓垮預算的那條曲線。

**證據**

三層都到齊了：Zaporizhzhia 那架 Molniya 由機上 Jetson Orin 自行選定丙烷儲罐；HUR 先前已在 Shahed MS001 發現同型模組執行終端導引，8 月 12 日又從 S-71M 殘骸取出一顆，可見這是產品線標準件而非單一實驗；而台灣審計部直指 NCSIST 開發的反無人機系統對 FOG-D 與 AI 導航無人機無可行反制手段——同一個機制，寫成了審計語言。

**各方自己怎麼說**

四方說法各自成立，互相攻擊的點也都很準，這段你對談時最用得上。

美國的立場是程序性的，而且常被誤述：DoDD 3000.09 從未禁止自主，它明文允許機上自主完成目標辨識、排序與終端導引，只要操作者保留對「個別目標或特定目標群」的選擇權。華府因此反對固定門檻，主張標準是「適當程度的人類判斷」。它最尖銳的一點：禁令只綁得住原本就打算遵守的人。

中國走雙軌，而且不太掩飾。2026 年 4 月中方表示願意締結新議定書，禁止全自主致命武器的「使用」——明確限於使用、不含開發；同一天，中國空軍公布評估全自主蜂群的競賽計畫。北京最尖銳的一點：軍事 AI 優勢累積在開發階段，只管使用的規則對先行者最有利。

俄羅斯是最小主義：現行 IHL 已足夠涵蓋高度自主武器，新規則只會不公平限制投資自主的國家。莫斯科真正的工具是 CCW 的共識決，一直當否決權用。

烏克蘭最誠實也最尷尬：它在聯大 A/79/408 投了棄權，官方支持人類在武力使用中的角色，但國防部公開目標是把操作員移出戰場，其產業正在量產把最後 500 公尺交給機器的模組。基輔最尖銳的一點：在部隊員額只剩三到六成的條件下，自主不是倫理選項，是它拿不出來的人力的替代品。

**未來 3–6 個月的推演與觀察指標**

CCW 第七次審查會議 11 月 16 至 20 日召開，GGE 三年授權在此屆滿，結果只有三種：拿到談判授權、再延一次討論性授權、或讓進程失效。以俄國的否決習慣與中國的「條件成熟論」判斷，最可能是第二種。真正的訊號不在會議結論，在四處：一、殘骸裡的模組還讀不讀得出來，Zaporizhzhia 能被證實純粹因為沒加密；二、烏方「6 至 9 個月內前線多數無人機配備自主模組」是否兌現；三、各國反無人機採購是否從 RF 干擾器移向聲學陣列、光學追蹤與攔截無人機；四、台灣那筆六年 NT$2,400 億到底買到什麼。

**我可能錯在哪**

最可能錯的是把「EW 層消失」講得太絕對。Sky Fortress 就是現成反證：約 14,000 個聲學節點、單價 400 至 1,000 美元、覆蓋全國約八成，完全不依賴目標發射無線電，總造價據報低於 500 萬美元。若廣域偵測能用這種價格重建，我說的「防守方被迫走向昂貴感測」就不成立，成本曲線只是換了一條、沒有翻轉。我的辯護是該網僅以純聲學追蹤到入境目標的約兩成，且聲學對低噪音小型電動機與高速目標都不友善；但這是程度問題不是原則問題，我的量化把握不高。同理，美方已展示 HPM 擊落光纖 FPV，若這類低單發成本手段成熟，攔截端曲線同樣可能再壓下來。
narrative.en:
**The question.** For two years the drone conversation has been about quantity — 300 sorties a day or 1,000. Quantity was never the real variable. There is only one: whether each airframe needs a human in its last few hundred meters. It sounds like an engineering detail, yet it decides three things: whether an attacker can convert production into strikes, whether the defender's cheapest layer of defense survives, and whether anyone can afterwards prove who chose the target.

**The mechanism.** Start with the attacker's arithmetic. Vyriy sells its Vyriy-10 with the TFL-1 terminal guidance module for about $448: roughly ten percent more per unit, two- to fourfold the strike effectiveness. That ratio is the engine. It requires no strategic decision about going autonomous, only a procurement officer who can divide.

Now the defender. Counter-drone cost per engagement spans five orders of magnitude — about a cent for electronic warfare effects, under $2,000 for guns, $3–5 million for an advanced missile interceptor. EW is nearly free because it expends no ordnance: it attacks the radio link itself. But TFL-1-class modules hand the last 500 meters to an onboard computer, and Russia's Molniya carries no external antenna at all. No link means nothing to jam. A ten percent premium on the attacker's side deletes an option five orders of magnitude cheaper on the defender's.

What it deletes is not only the intercept. EW is also the cheapest wide-area passive sensor a defender owns, listening for the emissions that announce an inbound. Against an RF-silent target you do not merely fail to stop it — you do not know where to look. Defenders fall back on acoustic, optical and radar coverage, which scales with area defended rather than threat count. That is the curve that breaks budgets.

**The evidence.** The Zaporizhzhia Molniya picked the propane tanks itself on an onboard Jetson Orin. HUR had already found the same module family running terminal guidance in Shahed MS001 airframes, and on 12 August pulled one from an S-71M cruise missile — a standard part across a line, not a one-off. And Taiwan's audit office found the NCSIST counter-drone system has no viable countermeasure against fiber-optic or AI-guided drones: the same mechanism, in audit language.

**How each side tells it.** All four accounts are coherent, and each aims at a real weakness in the others.

Washington's position is procedural and routinely misdescribed. DoDD 3000.09 never banned autonomy: it expressly permits onboard systems to identify, prioritize and terminally guide onto targets, provided the operator retains control over selection of individual targets or specific target groups. Hence its resistance to fixed thresholds, in favour of appropriate human judgment. Its sharpest point: a prohibition binds only those who meant to comply.

Beijing runs two tracks and barely conceals it. In April 2026 it offered to negotiate a protocol banning the use of fully autonomous lethal systems — use, explicitly not development. The same day, the PLA Air Force published a challenge evaluating fully autonomous swarms. Its sharpest point: military AI advantage accrues during development, so a use-only rule flatters whoever got there first.

Moscow is a minimalist: existing international humanitarian law already covers highly autonomous systems, and new rules would only constrain states investing in autonomy. Its real instrument is the CCW consensus rule, long used as a veto.

Kyiv's is the most honest and most awkward. Ukraine abstained on A/79/408 and formally supports human agency in the use of force, while its defense ministry's stated goal is to remove operators from the battlefield and its industry mass-produces the modules that take the last 500 meters. Its point: with units far below establishment strength, autonomy is not an ethical choice but a substitute for people it does not have.

**Next three to six months.** The CCW's Seventh Review Conference runs 16–20 November 2026 and the GGE's mandate expires into it: a negotiating mandate, another discussion-only rollover, or lapse. Given Russia's veto habit and China's conditions-must-mature formula, the rollover is likeliest. The signal is not in the communiqué. Watch four things: whether recovered modules stay readable, since Zaporizhzhia was provable only by the accident of no encryption; whether most front-line drones really do carry autonomy within six to nine months; whether counter-drone procurement shifts from RF jammers toward acoustic arrays, optical tracking and interceptor drones; and what Taiwan's NT$240 billion actually buys.

**Where I am most likely wrong.** The most probable error is stating the disappearance of the EW layer too absolutely. Sky Fortress is the ready counterexample: roughly 14,000 acoustic nodes at $400–1,000 each, covering about 80 percent of Ukraine, depending not at all on the target emitting radio, reportedly under $5 million all-in. If wide-area cueing can be rebuilt at that price, my claim that defenders are pushed onto expensive sensing fails, and the cost curve merely moved rather than inverted. My defense: the network tracks only about 20 percent of inbound targets on acoustics alone, and acoustics degrade badly against quiet electric airframes and fast targets — a matter of degree, not principle, and my quantitative confidence is low. The US has also demonstrated HPM defeating fiber-optic FPV drones; if low-cost-per-shot effectors mature, the intercept curve could be pushed back down.
